name: feature stat card beside a tilted phone mockup
looks: A big stat ("36 FITTING TAKEOUTS") with a small radial progress arc sits beside a slightly tilted phone mockup showing the app's dark-mode screen, both lit against a warm amber field. The card then hard-cuts to a bold "SEARCH" wordmark with a magnifying glass icon, closing the beat.
build: ui-tilt-card for the phone mockup (shallow rotateX/rotateY, soft offset shadow) beside a DOM stat block with an SVG radial-progress-anticipation arc; the exit is a hard cut to a centred word with an icon, no crossfade.
sound: A soft whoosh as the card settles, a blip on the arc fill, a hit on the SEARCH cut.
prompt: Pair a short, specific stat with a small progress arc beside a tilted device mockup showing the product's own screen, lit in one warm accent colour. Hard-cut out to a single bold word with a small icon that names the next capability.
